Not to be used on Metalized Plastic.Waxpol Scratch Remover (For Use on Mild Scratches on All Colours) 150 gmWaxpol Scratch Remover is for use on any color of paint. Unlike other products that hide and cover up scratches, this actually removes light scratches and swirl marks. It enhances paint color and clarity, to make the surface look like new. For removal of fine scratches, swirls, haze, blemishes, surface oxidation, bird droppings, tree sap, minor paint marks and water spotting.
